name: Alchemist's Fire
description: This can be thrown as a splash weapon dealing 1 point of moderate fire damage to all creatures within 5 feet. On a direct hit this damage is increased by the number of successes and sneak attack damage when appropriate

name: Hat of Disguise
description: This allows the wearer to benefit from the effects of Disguise Self. The appearance of the hat may be changed within the bounds of the spell but cannot be hidden.
